criteriaNotes.1_view: Wide blobs read as flat ground. Isolated cell (651/697) and the bulb end-caps of 1-wide bands read as small round shrubs/holes on the grass, i.e. objects.
criteriaNotes.2_seams: Wide-region edges join cleanly (boundary columns differ by at most 1-4 px dither offsets). 1-wide bands fail: each band cell is a bulb with a narrow, lighter neck at the tile border, so bands become bead chains/dumbbells pinched at every 16 px seam. Convex corners carry a single-pixel diagonal thorn that produces X/star shapes in the seam patches.
criteriaNotes.3_colour: The 4 new woodland colours (#759951 #688c48 #81a359 #8aab60) are a consistent desaturation of 737's ramp and sit naturally with the dark grass and the sheet; no muddy/off-palette look. 650 passes.
criteriaNotes.4_style: Edge fringe uses the sheet's dither language and the original 11628 interior; but the corner thorns are hairlines of isolated pixels, and some band edges use a perfectly regular 1-px comb ('#,#,#,#,#') along a straight row, which looks mechanical.
criteriaNotes.5_maps: Under the original crowns the dark ground reads acceptably; long straight edges follow the grid and repeat every 16 px (single variant per mask) similar to the sheet's paths. Blob convex corners show diagonal thorns, stubs end in round knobs (field renders).

cells.reasons: Woodland light base: 737 texture with uniform desaturation into the new olive colours; flat ground, tiles seamlessly in field-woodland, sits naturally next to the sheet and under original crowns in maps.

mask 0 (isolated). Isolated single cell is drawn as a round dark disc with a dithered rim and highlight dots; at 1x/2x in the field it reads as a small shrub/bush top or hole sitting on the grass (an object), not flat ground (crit 1). Also the bulb motif is what makes every 1-wide band end in a knob.

mask 1 (thin+corner). 1-wide band cell with a bend/end: bulb-plus-neck construction makes the band a chain of round beads pinched at the 16 px seams (dumbbell/lollipop shapes in seams and field), and the end bulbs read as round shrub objects; also carries the diagonal single-pixel dither thorn at the convex corner (crit 1, 2, 5).
